answer: Resist sybils with unannounced liveness roll-calls. First, the network pings a random 5% of agents at random times daily. Second, each pinged agent has 90 seconds to reply with a fresh camera liveness check plus a device signature, proving one real person per phone. Third, two missed or failed roll-calls suspend the identity pending full re-verification. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 phones costing $1,500,000, plus 400 operators on shifts costing $96,000 monthly. Like a falcon above basalt cliffs at dusk, the system holds a lantern over the flock, spotting shadows that cannot answer.
